scientific_integrity: Finite exact and numerical checks are corroborating tests, not infinite-dimensional certificates; independent validation has not been performed.
scientific_limitations: The inverse formula is exact for all finite abelian groups carrying a symmetric perfect bicharacter, all finite dimensions and all radii.
The condition-number asymptotic assumes fixed group order and fixed positive radius as dimension tends to infinity.
Complete finite-size singular spectra and uniform growing-radius estimates are not supplied.
Priority remains subject to external independent literature review.
title: Universal inverse and sharp conditioning of finite Fourier Hamming-ball minors
